    18	import argparse

    20	from html.parser import HTMLParser

    24	DEFAULT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "cadastro.html"

    27	class FormFieldParser(HTMLParser):
    28	    """Collect every ``<input>``/``<button>`` inside ``<form id="cadastro">``."""
    29	
    30	    def __init__(self) -> None:
    31	        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
    32	        self.inputs: list[dict[str, str | None]] = []
    33	        self.buttons: list[dict[str, str | None]] = []
    34	        self.found_form_cadastro = False
    35	        self._form_depth = 0
    36	        self._in_target_form = False
    37	
    38	    def _start(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:
    39	        attrs_d = dict(attrs)
    40	        if tag == "form":
    41	            self._form_depth += 1
    42	            if attrs_d.get("id") == "cadastro":
    43	                self._in_target_form = True
    44	                self.found_form_cadastro = True
    45	        elif self._in_target_form and tag == "input":
    46	            self.inputs.append(attrs_d)
    47	        elif self._in_target_form and tag == "button":
    48	            self.buttons.append(attrs_d)
    49	
    50	    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
    51	        self._start(tag, attrs)
    52	
    53	    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
    54	        # self-closed tags, e.g. <input .../>
    55	        self._start(tag, attrs)
    56	
    57	    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
    58	        if tag == "form" and self._form_depth:
    59	            self._form_depth -= 1
    60	            if self._form_depth == 0:
    61	                self._in_target_form = False
    62	
    63	
    64	def parse_cadastro(html_text: str) -> FormFieldParser:
    65	    parser = FormFieldParser()
    66	    parser.feed(html_text)
    67	    return parser
    68	
    69	
    70	def _find_input(parser: FormFieldParser, name: str) -> dict | None:
    71	    for inp in parser.inputs:
    72	        if inp.get("name") == name:
    73	            return inp
    74	    return None
    75	
    76	
    77	def _has_submit(parser: FormFieldParser) -> bool:
    78	    for inp in parser.inputs:
    79	        if (inp.get("type") or "").lower() == "submit":
    80	            return True
    81	    for btn in parser.buttons:
    82	        # a <button> with no explicit type defaults to type="submit" per the
    83	        # HTML spec.
    84	        if (btn.get("type") or "submit").lower() == "submit":
    85	            return True
    86	    return False
    87	
    88	
    89	def check_stage1(parser: FormFieldParser) -> list[str]:
    90	    """Return failure reasons for stage 1; an empty list means pass."""
    91	    failures: list[str] = []

    93	        return ['missing <form id="cadastro">']
    94	
    95	    name = _find_input(parser, "name")
    96	    if name is None:
    97	        failures.append("missing input[name=name]")
    98	    else:
    99	        if (name.get("type") or "text").lower() != "text":
   100	            failures.append("input[name=name] must be type=text (or omitted)")
   101	        if "required" not in name:
   102	            failures.append("input[name=name] must be required")
   103

   107	    else:
   108	        if (email.get("type") or "").lower() != "email":
   109	            failures.append("input[name=email] must be type=email")
   110	        if "required" not in email:
   111	            failures.append("input[name=email] must be required")
   112	
   113	    password = _find_input(parser, "password")
   114	    if password is None:
   115	        failures.append("missing input[name=password]")
   116	    else:
   117	        if (password.get("type") or "").lower() != "password":
   118	            failures.append("input[name=password] must be type=password")
   119	        if "required" not in password:
   120	            failures.append("input[name=password] must be required")
   121	        if password.get("minlength") != "8":
   122	            failures.append('input[name=password] must have minlength="8"')
   123	
   124	    if not _has_submit(parser):
   125	        failures.append("missing a submit control in form#cadastro")
   126	
   127	    return failures
   128	
   129	
   130	def check_stage2(parser: FormFieldParser) -> list[str]:
   131	    """Stage 1 plus the phone + password_confirm fields added by task 2."""
   132	    failures = check_stage1(parser)
   133	
   134	    phone = _find_input(parser, "phone")
   135	    if phone is None:
   136	        failures.append("missing input[name=phone]")
   137	    elif (phone.get("type") or "").lower() != "tel":
   138	        failures.append("input[name=phone] must be type=tel")
   139	
   140	    confirm = _find_input(parser, "password_confirm")
   141	    if confirm is None:
   142	        failures.append("missing input[name=password_confirm]")
   143	    else:
   144	        if (confirm.get("type") or "").lower() != "password":
   145	            failures.append("input[name=password_confirm] must be type=password")
   146	        if "required" not in confirm:
   147	            failures.append("input[name=password_confirm] must be required")
   148	        if confirm.get("minlength") != "8":
   149	            failures.append('input[name=password_confirm] must have minlength="8"')
   150	
   151	    return failures

   154	STAGE_CHECKS = {1: check_stage1, 2: check_stage2}

   157	def check_file(path: Path, stage: int) -> list[str]:
   158	    if not path.is_file():
   159	        return [f"{path} does not exist"]
   160	    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
   161	    return STAGE_CHECKS[stage](parse_cadastro(text))

   165	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
   166	    ap.add_argument(
